the effect of Na-site doping on enhancing the lithium storage performance of sodium lithium titanate, which provides an alternative approach for designing high-performance anode materials for rechargeable lithium batteries.

the Na-site substitution by metal ions with high valence states is a promising strategy to develop high-performance lithium storage hosts.
